versions.content: The service TcpIp_IcmpV6Transmit() shall (a) construct an ICMPv 6 message according to the parameters Type, Code, DataLength and DataPtr and (b) transmit the ICMPv 6 message using the local IP address and EthIf controller specified by LocalIpAddrId to the destination specified by RemoteAddrPtr using a Hop Limit value according to the parameter HopLimit.
